{"answer":"WITH refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
), paid_order_nets AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         o.id AS order_id,
         o.amount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
), customer_totals AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         COUNT(order_id) AS paid_order_count,
         SUM(net_cents) AS net_cents
  FROM paid_order_nets
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       COALESCE(ct.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(ct.net_cents, 0) AS net_cents
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN customer_totals AS ct ON ct.customer_id = c.id
ORDER BY c.id;"}
